title: Instance uniform is stuck using color even after removing `source_color` hint
body:
### Tested versions

4.7  beta4

### System information

W10

### Issue description

`source_color` in 2D instance instance uniforms turns out to be bugged right now (#102746), so I tried to remove the hint as a workaround. To my surprise, the color was still bugged. After some investigating, seems like the shader is permanently keeping the Color value and can't be reset. You have to paste a Vector3/4 from somewhere else to fix it.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2ce51afa-584a-4e9c-9028-2f2bd3f69547

There are some very nasty Variant shenanigans involved here. What I think is happening is the shader is inferring its default value from the assigned value, hence even reverting does not help. The Color value is stored in the scene, so it gets assigned every time and triggers the inconsistency. The editor for some reason uses the editing control for the _declared_ value type and happily accepts the wrong type, converting it internally.

The only way to fix this is either pasting a Vector3/4 value into the uniform, or manually removing the value from the scene file.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make a ColorRect
2. Paste this shader
```gdshader
shader_type canvas_item;

instance uniform vec3 color : source_color;

void fragment() {
	COLOR.rgb = color;
}
```
3. Assign some color to the uniform that's affected by sRGB <=> Linear conversion (in my case `3a504d`).
4. Remove `source_color`.
5. Try to make the uniform show correct color.
